# Set up data
```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/rsc51785/Dropbox/Correia_PhD_Research/Courses/Fall 2026/WILD 8390/Final Project")

deerdata <- read.csv("deerdata.csv")

head(deerdata)
str(deerdata)

library(survival)

#create survival object
#event = 1 is mortality, event = 0 is right-censored (survived)
y <- Surv(deerdata$survival_time, deerdata$event)
y 
```


# Overall Kaplan-Meier survival (2.2.1.)
```{r}
#Estimate overall Kaplan-Meier survival function
km.all <- survfit(y ~ 1)
km.all


#Plot overall Kaplan-Meier curve
plot(km.all,
     xlab = "Days since capture",
     ylab = "Survivorship",
     main = "Kaplan-Meier Survival")
```


# Kaplan-Meier by Sex (M/F) (2.2.1.)
```{r}
#Male vs. female Kaplan-Meier function
km.sex <- survfit(y ~ sex, data = deerdata)
km.sex


#Plot the Kaplan-Meier curve
plot(km.sex,
     col = c("steelblue", "firebrick"),
     lty = 1,
     lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Days since capture",
     ylab = "Survivorship",
     main = "Kaplan-Meier Survival by Sex")
legend("bottomleft",
       legend = c("Female", "Male"),
       col = c("steelblue", "firebrick"),
       lty = 1,
       lwd = 2)

#Compare survival distributions between males and females
survdiff(y ~ sex, data = deerdata)
```

# Parametric survival model (2.2.2.)
```{r}
#Sex
pm.sex <- survreg(y ~ sex, data = deerdata, dist = "exponential")
summary(pm.sex)

#Age 
pm.age <- survreg(y ~ age_at_capture, data = deerdata, dist = "exponential")
summary(pm.age)

#Combined sex and age 
pm.both <- survreg(y ~ sex + age_at_capture, data = deerdata, dist = "exponential")
summary(pm.both)
```

# Plot hazard rates by sex (2.2.2.)
```{r}
alpha.hat <- coef(pm.sex)
hazard.F <- 1/exp(alpha.hat[1])
hazard.M <- 1/exp(alpha.hat[1] + alpha.hat[2])
par(mar = c(5, 8, 4, 2),
    mgp = c(4, 1, 0))
barplot(c(hazard.F, hazard.M),
        names.arg = c("Female", "Male"),
        col = c("gray70", "gray40"),
        ylab = "Estimated daily mortality hazard",
        xlab = "Sex",
        main = "Estimated Mortality Hazard by Sex",
        cex.main = 1.1,
        cex.lab = 0.9,
        cex.axis = 0.85,
        las = 1,
        ylim = c(0, 0.0035))
```


# Plot hazard rates by age (2.2.2.)
```{r}
alpha.hat <- coef(pm.age)
plot(function(x) 1/exp(alpha.hat[1] + alpha.hat[2]*x),
     from = min(deerdata$age_at_capture, na.rm = TRUE),
     to = max(deerdata$age_at_capture, na.rm = TRUE),
     xlab = "Age at capture (years)",
     ylab = "Estimated daily mortality hazard",
     col = "blue",
     lwd = 2)
```


# Cox proportional hazards models (2.2.3)
```{r}
#Sex
cox.sex <- coxph(y ~ sex, data = deerdata)
summary(cox.sex)

#Age
cox.age <- coxph(y ~ age_at_capture, data = deerdata)
summary(cox.age)

#Combined sex and age
cox.both <- coxph(y ~ sex + age_at_capture, data = deerdata)
summary(cox.both)

#Test proprtional hazards assumption
cox.zph(cox.sex)
cox.zph(cox.age)
cox.zph(cox.both)
```


# Cox model plot (2.2.3)
```{r}
#Create data for male and female deer at mean age
newdata <- data.frame(
  sex = c("F", "M"),
  age_at_capture = rep(mean(deerdata$age_at_capture,
                            na.rm = TRUE), 2))

#Calculate predicted survival
cox.pred <- survfit(cox.both, newdata = newdata)

#Adjust margins
par(mar = c(5, 6, 3, 2),
    mgp = c(3.5, 1, 0))

#Plot predicted survival
plot(cox.pred,
     col = c("steelblue", "firebrick"),
     lwd = 2,
     lty = 1,
     xlab = "Days since capture",
     ylab = "Survivorship",
     main = "Cox Proportional Hazards Model",
     ylim = c(0, 1),
     mark.time = FALSE,
     las = 1)

#Add legend
legend("bottomleft",
       legend = c("Female", "Male"),
       col = c("steelblue", "firebrick"),
       lwd = 2,
       lty = 1,
       bty = "n")
```


# Effect of mortality source (descriptive)
```{r}
#Mortality source
mortality.table <- table(deerdata$sex, deerdata$mortality_source)

mortality.table

#Mortality percentages by sex
prop.table(mortality.table, margin = 1) * 100
```


# Competing risks analysis (2.2.4.)
```{r}
#3 mortality causes - hunter, natural, and other

#Create competing risks event factor
deerdata$event_cr <- factor(
  deerdata$event_code,
  levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3),
  labels = c("censored", "hunter", "natural", "other"))

#Fit competing risks model
cr_model <- survfit(Surv(survival_time, event_cr) ~ 1, data = deerdata)
summary(cr_model)


#Competing risks model by sex
cr_sex <- survfit(Surv(survival_time, event_cr) ~ sex, data = deerdata)
summary(cr_sex)

table(deerdata$sex, deerdata$event_cr)
```
